dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, light-colored 'O' and 'C' shaped outlines exhibiting jagged, high-contrast perimeters. dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low density of solid-core high-intensity blobs; the majority of the texture is defined by hollow annuli. Sparse, small, solid light-pixel clusters are localized along the lower mid-section boundary.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Three prominent dorsal annuli form a non-equilateral triangle in the upper-mid torso, with a secondary chain of smaller annuli extending posteriorly along the dorsal ridge.
